entire_current_literal.source_text: The image of a box is a zonotope. $W$ maps $\{\|\delta\|_\infty\le\varepsilon\}$ to a sum of segments $\varepsilon[-w_j,w_j]$ over its columns (a parallelogram for invertible $2\times2$ $W$). The tightest enclosing box has half-widths $\varepsilon\|w_{i,:}\|_1$, which is what interval bound propagation keeps: for $W=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1\\ 1 & -1\end{bmatrix}$, $\varepsilon=1$, the image is the square with corners $(\pm2,0),(0,\pm2)$, area $8$, inside the box $[-2,2]^2$ of area $16$.
